unresolved.reason: chair role in announced transition at document date
unresolved.detail: Proxy of 2025-03-18: the current Chair Roger W. Ferguson, Jr. signs the letter as 'Chair of the Board of Directors' but is not among the ten nominees, and the letter announces that 'Kevin O’Byrne will become our new Board Chair at the 2025 Annual Shareholder Meeting' (O'Byrne's biography: 'expected to be appointed Non-Executive Chair of the Board following the 2025 Annual Meeting'). Chair is therefore in announced transition at the document date (protocol: do not decide). Other facts found: ten nominees; 'All Directors other than our CEO are Independent' (CEO J. Erik Fyrwald, CEO since February 2024); outgoing directors Gold, Davidson and Hu (named in the letter as stepping down) and Ferguson still sit at the document date, so the in-place count of directors was not reconciled.

unresolved.reason: chair role in announced transition at document date
unresolved.detail: Proxy of 2025-11-26 (annual meeting Jan 2026): currently the roles are separate with independent Board Chair Nora Johnson, but the document announces (20 Nov 2025) that Johnson 'will not be standing for reelection at the Meeting' and that the Board 'has appointed Mr. Goodarzi, our CEO, as Board Chair and Mr. Prabhu, an independent director, as Lead Independent Director, effective as of the date of the Meeting', i.e. the leadership structure changes from separate to combined at the meeting. Chair in announced transition (protocol: do not decide). Other facts found: 13 current directors ('Eleven of the Board’s 13 current directors are standing for election'), 'All non-employee directors are independent' (12 of 13, CEO Sasan Goodarzi not independent).
